title: Open a file or URL with the default application
summary: Use xdg-open to launch files, images, PDFs, or web links in the applications you have set as default. This is useful when you want to open something without manually selecting a program.

steps.explain: Open a specific file (like an image or PDF) or a URL in its default application.

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_URL
placeholders.description: The path to the file or the URL you want to open.

alternatives.explain: Open the current directory in the default file manager.
